--!strict
-- The scene the `SubWorld` specs run (ADR 0107 §3): it says what it can see,
-- answers what it is sent, and reports the input it is given.

local SceneService = game:GetService("SceneService")

local context = Instance.new("InputContext")
local jump = Instance.new("InputAction")
jump.Name = "Jump"
jump.Parent = context
local move = Instance.new("InputAction")
move.Name = "Move"
move.Type = Enum.InputActionType.Direction2D
move.Parent = context
context.Parent = script

jump.Pressed:Connect(function()
    SceneService:SendToHost("jump")
end)
move.StateChanged:Connect(function()
    local state = move:GetState() :: Vector2
    SceneService:SendToHost("move", state.X, state.Y)
end)

SceneService.HostMessageReceived:Connect(function(...: any)
    SceneService:SendToHost("echo", ...)
end)

-- One level deep: a sub-world may not load one of its own.
local nested = Instance.new("SubWorld")
local nestedLoaded = pcall(function()
    nested:Load()
end)
nested:Destroy()

SceneService:SendToHost(
    "started",
    SceneService:IsSubWorld(),
    workspace:FindFirstChild("HostMarker") ~= nil,
    nestedLoaded,
    SceneService.CurrentScene
)
